name: catalyst
description: Ticket orchestration pattern for coding agents — fan out, reduce, verify, synthesize. Decomposes tickets into parallel investigation tasks, consolidates findings, skeptically re-verifies each against real code, and only then produces an implementation plan.
author: {org}

commands.name: catalyst
commands.description: Run the full fan-out/reduce/verify/synthesize pattern on a ticket

commands.name: catalyst-install
commands.description: Install the canonical orchestration pattern into CLAUDE.md

commands.name: add-skill
commands.description: Add a new ticket-type skill to .catalyst/skills/

commands.name: add-template
commands.description: Add Catalyst support for a new agent tool

commands.name: build-catalyst
commands.description: Build deployable zip bundles for all supported tools

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Review session lessons and distill durable skills

agents.name: catalyst-orchestrator
agents.description: Decomposes tickets, delegates to analyst/verifier/synthesizer, consolidates

agents.name: catalyst-fan-out-analyst
agents.description: Runs one read-only investigation task, returns structured findings

agents.name: catalyst-verifier
agents.description: Skeptically re-checks one finding against actual code or tests

agents.name: catalyst-synthesizer
agents.description: Turns verified findings into a concrete implementation plan

agents.name: catalyst-code-reviewer
agents.description: Post-implementation review of written code against the ticket

skills.name: bug-fix
skills.description: Playbook for tickets that report something broken — crash, wrong output, regression, failing test

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Playbook for reviewing a PR, diff, or set of changes before merge

skills.name: feature-implementation
skills.description: Playbook for implementing new capability that does not currently exist

files.description: Canonical instruction block (paste into CLAUDE.md or any agent instruction file)
Optional subagent layer: named roles, model assignment, when to use
Optional worktree layer: isolated git worktrees per ticket
